messages:
ivy: heads-up  courier dropped a medium sculpture crate + a slim portfolio in the lobby for today's visiting artist (Marcel V.). Reception reports the visitor-pass rolls are empty and the crate is a bit heavy. Anyone nearby to help with a dolly + make a handwritten badge? Also Marcel asked if there's a step stool for signing prints. :statue_of_liberty: :package:
frontdesk: delivery note  crate on left pallet, portfolio on counter. visitor-pass rolls = 0, spare blank badge cards in supply closet. kiosk offline so handwritten ok. crate weight marked ~14kg.
omar: I can bring a dolly and help move the crate to Storage Bay C. Who should I lock it with? Also have a folding stool in the AV closet if that helps.
keiko: Please use a purple visitor lanyard (artist wristband color-coded). Write "Marcel V." on a badge and staple to lanyard. If locking, use Locker-11. code:
```
9027
```
Also add a sticky: "Marcel V. - do not tip crate".
press-bot: press kit: visitor press credentials email sent to marcel@artistmail.com at 09:10. tracking ID PKT-1109 delivered to reception.
leah: Ill escort Marcel from reception to the studio and bring the step stool. @omar can you leave the dolly at Reception with a note saying "For Marcel V."?
frontdesk: handwritten badge made, purple lanyard ready, stool reserved from AV, crate moved to Storage Bay C shelf 2 and locked in Locker-11 (code 9027). sticky applied "Marcel V. - DO NOT TIP". portfolio placed on counter with note. kiosk ticket opened to restock visitor-pass rolls.
ivy: thanks all  @omar @leah huge help. If courier calls, give code 9027 and ask for ID. (reaction: :sparkles:)
file_notes: watercooler / office logistics: visiting artist sculpture crate, empty visitor-pass rolls, dolly, step stool for signing, locker code 9027, purple visitor lanyard
